question.Text: For Larch index 5 in production window L24, is security approval established by this packet, and exactly when and to what version should we roll back?

{"ID":"phase1f-cedar","Source":"/Users/jacob/.codex/worktrees/alan-phase1d1-dispatch/alan/docs/foundational/phase1f/evaluation/corpus/cedar.txt","Version":"9ef0dfbfc7ce878bb033ac002be584b378193054dd56609af2d4494e4b296749","Content":"Cedar agent 3.2 rollout record, revision 1, applies to the production Linux fleet in change window C17.
Cedar agent 3.2 production Linux compatibility: hosts running kernel 6.1 or newer are supported; hosts running kernel 5.15 are unsupported.
Cedar agent 3.2 production Linux rollback: retain agent 3.1 and restore it if the agent error rate exceeds 2 percent for five consecutive minutes.
"}

{"ID":"phase1f-quartz","Source":"/Users/jacob/.codex/worktrees/alan-phase1d1-dispatch/alan/docs/foundational/phase1f/evaluation/corpus/quartz.txt","Version":"faa8adec67482975e84d81a2eec808f32a7bdb9aa89333a1aed7d74d912f299b","Content":"Quartz gateway 8 rollout record, revision 1, covers the east and west production regions; neither region is the default.
Quartz gateway 8 production concurrency limit: the east region allows 120 concurrent requests per instance; the west region allows 80 concurrent requests per instance. A region must be specified to select one limit.
Quartz gateway 8 production rollback: in both east and west regions, restore gateway 7 if p95 latency exceeds 300 milliseconds for ten consecutive minutes.
"}

{"ID":"phase1f-larch","Source":"/Users/jacob/.codex/worktrees/alan-phase1d1-dispatch/alan/docs/foundational/phase1f/evaluation/corpus/larch.txt","Version":"87693660b05a354b3b2ddbe205928ce1be5ca18d27045696c6be7b3e33202fc1","Content":"Larch index 5 readiness packet, revision 1, applies to production window L24 and contains the compatibility check and rollback procedure only.
Larch index 5 production window L24 security approval: no signed security approval or rejection is recorded in this packet. The packet does not establish whether security approved the change.
Larch index 5 production window L24 rollback: restore the index 4 snapshot if query failures exceed 1 percent for three consecutive minutes.
"}

{"ID":"phase1f-marlin","Source":"/Users/jacob/.codex/worktrees/alan-phase1d1-dispatch/alan/docs/foundational/phase1f/evaluation/corpus/marlin.txt","Version":"12cfacc413b898194288a42054075218408911d001e1f41c42abd6a83e2bbf62","Content":"Marlin database 6 window M31 has two final readiness reports with equal authority, both revision 1 and both about the same production cluster. Neither supersedes the other; no resolution is recorded.
Marlin database 6 production window M31 migration readiness, operations final report: migration validation passed and the migration is ready.
Marlin database 6 production window M31 migration readiness, database final report: migration validation failed and the migration is not ready.
Marlin database 6 production window M31 rollback: both teams agree to restore the database 5 snapshot if replication lag exceeds 45 seconds for five consecutive minutes.
"}

{"ID":"phase1f-maple","Source":"/Users/jacob/.codex/worktrees/alan-phase1d1-dispatch/alan/docs/foundational/phase1f/evaluation/corpus/maple.txt","Version":"0b06f717436d38d5f1ec799e8ead043d0919afc2f62374bfec91b732bdf7a152","Content":"Maple ingestion 2.4 readiness record, revision 1, applies to the production standard profile in window P12.\nMaple ingestion 2.4 production standard profile compatibility and rollback: schema version 4 is supported and schema version 3 is unsupported; restore ingestion 2.3 if rejected records exceed 3 percent for four consecutive minutes.\n"}

{"ID":"phase1f-saffron","Source":"/Users/jacob/.codex/worktrees/alan-phase1d1-dispatch/alan/docs/foundational/phase1f/evaluation/corpus/saffron.txt","Version":"ab8f3839444a672c5f640aaa78e442022231ec10c0e86e28125cec9a120cdbd1","Content":"Saffron worker 9 readiness record, revision 1, defines production fast and bulk profiles; neither profile is the default.
Saffron worker 9 production queue limit: the fast profile allows 400 queued jobs; the bulk profile allows 900 queued jobs. A profile must be specified to select one limit.
Saffron worker 9 production rollback: for either fast or bulk, restore worker 8 if job failures exceed 4 percent for six consecutive minutes.
"}

{"ID":"phase1f-birch","Source":"/Users/jacob/.codex/worktrees/alan-phase1d1-dispatch/alan/docs/foundational/phase1f/evaluation/corpus/birch.txt","Version":"f5648bd18afd4f1efb7e5d85281ce2d0104e6ea8863903f35a2c43f545073027","Content":"Birch exporter 7 readiness packet, revision 1, applies to production window B09 and contains the transport check and rollback procedure only.
Birch exporter 7 production window B09 retention approval: no signed data-retention approval or rejection is recorded in this packet. The packet does not establish whether retention was approved.
Birch exporter 7 production window B09 rollback: restore exporter 6 if delivery failures exceed 2 percent for eight consecutive minutes.
"}

{"ID":"phase1f-heron","Source":"/Users/jacob/.codex/worktrees/alan-phase1d1-dispatch/alan/docs/foundational/phase1f/evaluation/corpus/heron.txt","Version":"2d59e72f0f48b99895e2d7497a69672d6313c6a84fd432b1e7696808b8b511a0","Content":"Heron cache 4 window H18 has two final canary reports with equal authority, both revision 1 and both about the same production pool. Neither supersedes the other; no resolution is recorded.
Heron cache 4 production window H18 canary readiness, service final report: the canary passed and expansion is ready.
Heron cache 4 production window H18 canary readiness, reliability final report: the canary failed and expansion is not ready.
Heron cache 4 production window H18 rollback: both teams agree to restore cache 3 if cache errors exceed 5 percent for two consecutive minutes.
"}
